highlights: Result Update 13th November, 2026 BUY Target Price 3,320 Ethos Ltd Retail 1 Growth Momentum Continues; Maintain BUY Est.

Actual for Q2FY27: Revenue – BEAT; EBITDA – MISS; PAT – INLINE Changes in Estimates post Q2FY27 FY27E/FY28E: Revenue: -2%/-2%; EBITDA: -13%/-11%; PAT: -20%/-16% Recommendation Rationale • Strong Revenue Momentum: Ethos delivered robust revenue growth of 30% YoY in Q2FY27, driven by healthy SSSG of 15%, continued store expansion and a favourable premium product mix, reflected in an ASP of Rs 2.22 Lc.
The company added two boutiques during the quarter and another in Q3FY27 till date, taking its network to 106 boutiques across 35 cities.

Additionally, the onboarding of 27 new watch brands and 12 boutique additions further strengthened its portfolio and leadership position in the luxury watch retail segment. • Margin Performance: Gross margin improved 23 bps YoY to 29%; however, EBITDA margin contracted 63 bps YoY, primarily due to higher operating expenses associated with aggressive store expansion, including a 46% YoY increase in employee costs.

Additionally, the quarter included a one-off expense of Rs 5 Cr towards the GPHG Exhibition 2026 in Mumbai, which showcased 78 of the 84 nominated timepieces across 14 categories. • Expanding Reach Through New Retail Formats: The company has introduced Hour Studio, an online retail format targeting the Rs 10,000-2 Lc watch segment to broaden its customer reach.
